verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy has public API reference docs and a Test mode for building integrations, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples in the reference. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec that could power one. Test mode is a sandbox environment, which is adjacent to this story rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
